description: Source code for Android's AudioHardware implementation, managing audio streams, routing, and device control for a Samsung Crespo device within the Android platform.

classes.name: AudioHardware
classes.description: Main class managing audio hardware, streams, routing, and device control.

classes.name: AudioStreamOutALSA
classes.description: Represents an output audio stream using ALSA.

classes.name: AudioStreamInALSA
classes.description: Represents an input audio stream using ALSA.

classes.name: DownSampler
classes.description: Handles resampling of audio data between different sample rates.

methods.name: loadRILD
methods.description: Loads RIL client library and resolves function pointers.

methods.name: connectRILDIfRequired
methods.description: Connects to RIL if not already connected.

methods.name: openOutputStream
methods.description: Creates and opens an ALSA output stream.

methods.name: closeOutputStream
methods.description: Closes the specified output stream.

methods.name: openInputStream
methods.description: Creates and opens an ALSA input stream.

methods.name: closeInputStream
methods.description: Closes the specified input stream.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the current audio mode, managing routing and streams accordingly.

methods.name: setMicMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the microphone.

methods.name: getMicMute
methods.description: Retrieves the current microphone mute state.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets various audio parameters like TTY mode and Bluetooth noise reduction.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current audio parameters.

methods.name: getInputBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates buffer size for input streams based on sample rate and format.

methods.name: setVoiceVolume
methods.description: Adjusts the voice call volume.

methods.name: setMasterVolume
methods.description: Sets the master volume (software handled).

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state for debugging.

methods.name: setIncallPath_l
methods.description: Configures audio routing for in-call mode.

methods.name: openPcmOut_l
methods.description: Opens PCM output device.

methods.name: closePcmOut_l
methods.description: Closes PCM output device.

methods.name: openMixer_l
methods.description: Opens mixer device.

methods.name: closeMixer_l
methods.description: Closes mixer device.

methods.name: getOutputRouteFromDevice
methods.description: Returns string route name for output device.

methods.name: getVoiceRouteFromDevice
methods.description: Returns string route name for voice call device.

methods.name: getInputRouteFromDevice
methods.description: Returns string route name for input device.

methods.name: getInputSampleRate
methods.description: Selects closest supported input sample rate.

methods.name: getActiveInput_l
methods.description: Returns currently active input stream.

methods.name: setInputSource_l
methods.description: Sets the input source for recording.

methods.name: AudioStreamOutALSA::write
methods.description: Writes audio data to PCM device.

methods.name: AudioStreamOutALSA::standby
methods.description: Puts output stream into standby.

methods.name: AudioStreamOutALSA::doStandby_l
methods.description: Internal standby implementation for output stream.

methods.name: AudioStreamOutALSA::close_l
methods.description: Closes PCM and mixer for output stream.

methods.name: AudioStreamOutALSA::open_l
methods.description: Opens PCM and mixer for output stream.

methods.name: AudioStreamInALSA::read
methods.description: Reads audio data from PCM device.

methods.name: AudioStreamInALSA::standby
methods.description: Puts input stream into standby.

methods.name: AudioStreamInALSA::doStandby_l
methods.description: Internal standby implementation for input stream.

methods.name: AudioStreamInALSA::close_l
methods.description: Closes PCM and mixer for input stream.

methods.name: AudioStreamInALSA::open_l
methods.description: Opens PCM and mixer for input stream.

methods.name: DownSampler::resample
methods.description: Performs resampling of audio data.

methods.name: DownSampler::reset
methods.description: Resets internal buffers.
